scientific_integrity: The t=1 unsigned count and t=-1 signed evaluation are treated as known or implied by broader prior results. The claim is the complete five-base edge-disagreement polynomial; bounded graph enumeration is not used as infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Complete full-rank formula is restricted to K_(2,2,n) and the part-order reference orientation; other multipartite part vectors and reference orientations are not classified. Historical priority is provisional.
title: Five-base acyclic-orientation rank polynomial for \(K_{2,2,n}\)
